Subject: Mutual onboarding plan: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service-account gating for NovaWave

Hi Elena — great to meet earlier today. Quick email to align on the access controls scope and next steps so CS/Engineering can start the implementation sprint next week. High-level objectives:  

- Enable SAML SSO (IdP: Okta) and SCIM provisioning for users/groups.
- Finalize IP allowlist ranges for our staging and prod endpoints.
- Define service-account pattern and ephemeral key rotation for NovaWave CI.

I attached a mutual-action-plan spreadsheet with recommended milestones and owners (see tab 2 for security checklist). Action items I propose for this week:  
1) You confirm primary IdP contact and SCIM user mapping (email, role, group).
2) Send the list of IP CIDR candidates for allowlisting (we can give feedback on minimum set).
3) Confirm whether the CI systems can accept short-lived service-account tokens; otherwise we'll provision dedicated service accounts with IP-restrictions.

I'll loop in Priyom (on our access playbook/SCIM templates) and Monica (CS lead) to coordinate the runbook and cutover windows. If you prefer a short working session instead of back-and-forth, we can do a 30-minute sync Tue morning PST.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mutual onboarding plan: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service-account gating for NovaWave

Ben — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers and a few asks from our side:  

- IdP: We're on Okta. Primary: Chris O'Neill (cc'ed). He will share Okta admin details and the SAML metadata URL.
- SCIM: We want email -> username, and group membership mapped to product roles (admin, engineer, auditor). We'll share a sample CSV.
- IP allowlist: Attached is a starting export of our egress NAT IPs and a filtered set we think are relevant (novawave_allowlist_candidates.csv). Some of our internal services are in AWS us-east-1 and GCP us-central; we may need a two-range approach for staging vs prod.
- Service accounts: Our CI currently uses long-lived keys for historical reasons; we are planning a rotation but estimate a 2-week work to adopt short-lived tokens. Can Redwood support a temporary window (we'd like to cutover with a canary first)?

We prefer the Tue morning sync — 09:30 AM EST (06:30 PT) works for Chris and me. Please send a calendar invite with objectives: SAML/SCIM owners, IP ranges, service-account plan, and tentative rollback/rollback window for the cutover.

Elena
